S2.text: First, check what you have. There's no voice key here, so this voice is a free one that runs locally.

S3.text: Write the words before any code. Even this line was written there first.

S4.text: Plan it to the frame. Every sound, this voice included, starts on a frame a scene exports.

S5.text: Build from one shared kit, one file per scene.

S6.text: Before the full render, read a still of every scene. That's where layout bugs show up.

S7.text: Render, then measure. These numbers come from this video's own first render.
